title.target: Participle and absolute constructions in literary prose
title.en: Participle and absolute constructions in literary prose

ex.t: At long last they reached the summit.
He paused to catch his breath.

title.ko: 분사구문과 독립 분사구문: Having done ... · The door being open ... · Weather permitting · Pausing, she ...
title.en: participle and absolute constructions: having done, the door being open, weather permitting, pausing, she

explain.ko: 분사구문은 접속사와 주어를 생략해 문장을 간결하게 합니다. 완료 분사구문 Having p.p.는 앞선 행동을 나타내고, 독립 분사구문은 The rain having stopped처럼 자신의 주어를 가집니다. Weather permitting, all things considered 같은 굳어진 독립 분사구문도 있습니다. 분사구문의 의미상 주어는 주절의 주어와 같아야 하며, 그렇지 않으면 의미가 모호해집니다.
explain.en: Participle clauses drop the conjunction and subject to make sentences concise. The perfect participle Having p.p. shows an earlier action, and an absolute construction such as The rain having stopped has its own subject. Fixed absolutes include Weather permitting and all things considered. The implied subject of a participle clause should match that of the main clause, or the meaning becomes ambiguous.

notes.ko: 분사구문의 주어는 주절의 주어와 일치해야 합니다.
notes.en: A participle clause's subject should match the main clause.

notes.ko: 독립 분사구문은 격식체이므로 일상 대화에서는 드뭅니다.
notes.en: Absolute constructions are formal and rare in conversation.

notes.ko: 완료 분사구문은 행동의 순서를 분명히 합니다.
notes.en: Perfect participles make the order of actions clear.

examples.t: All things considered, it is an excellent result.
examples.ko: 모든 것을 고려하면 그것은 훌륭한 결과예요.

questions.q: What did the man do after reading the report?

lines.t: Participle clauses make sentences concise and give literary prose an elegant flow. A perfect participle clause (having + past participle) shows an earlier action, and an absolute construction introduces a participle phrase with its own subject. Make the subject clear to avoid misreading.

trans.ko: 분사구문은 문장을 간결하게 만들고 문학적 산문에 우아한 흐름을 줍니다. 완료 분사구문(having + 과거분사)은 앞선 행동을 나타내고, 독립 분사구문은 주어가 다른 분사구를 이끕니다. 주어를 분명히 하여 오해를 피하세요.

questions.q: What does having + past participle show?

lines.t: The sentences in this scene are too long.
Try shortening them with participle clauses.
Something like 'Having closed the door, he left quietly.'

trans.ko:

편집자: 분사구문으로 줄여 보세요.
작가: 예를 들면요?
편집자: '문을 닫고 나서, 그는 조용히 떠났다'처럼요.

prompt.ko: 완료 분사구문과 독립 분사구문을 사용해 한 장면을 4문장으로 묘사해 보세요.
prompt.en: Describe a scene in four sentences using perfect participle and absolute constructions.

task.model: Having finished the letter, she went to the window. The rain having stopped, the street was still. Pausing to catch her breath, she opened the door. Weather permitting, she meant to go for a walk.

model_trans.ko: 편지를 다 쓰고 나서 그녀는 창가로 갔어요. 비가 그쳐서 거리는 고요했어요. 잠시 멈추어 숨을 고른 뒤 그녀는 문을 열었어요. 날씨가 허락한다면 산책을 나갈 생각이었어요.
model_trans.en: Having finished the letter, she went to the window. The rain having stopped, the street was still. Pausing to catch her breath, she opened the door. Weather permitting, she meant to go for a walk.
